name: InitOscillator
evidence: slot 0 of class 0x8D: runs InitObject, then sets the index at +0x40 and the index at +0x6D0 to -1 and the scale at +0x34 to -1.0

name: AttachNodeToOwner
evidence: puts the context's node at the head of the owner's list at +0x8E0, sets the node's owner, and for every element and listed slot stores the owner's matching item address into the slot's pointers (items at +0x6E0 and +0x7E0)

name: RefreshOscillatorFrames
evidence: EvaluateOscillator calls it while the dirty flag +0x8E4 of a class 0x8D object is set: rebuilds the entries' matrices (InitIdentityMatrix, BuildMatrixFromRotationAndTranslation, MultiplyMatrices, InvertMatrix4x4)

name: ComputeOscillatorDisplacement
evidence: original assembly: sums over a class 0x8D object's 0xD0-byte entries (count +0x38, from +0x50) the displacement each kind-0 entry with a period above the limit gives a point (ComputeSinCos of its phase), recursing into chained oscillators; the gauge, effect and attached-set code and func_001D66A8 call it

name: ComputeOscillatorMaxDisplacement
evidence: writes, per axis, the sum over the kind-0 entries of a class 0x8D object of the amplitude sqrt(a*a + b*b) of their two components (+0x20 and +0x40): the largest displacement they can give; UpdateAttachedSetBounds calls it

name: HashToUnitFloat
evidence: mixes an integer with xor-shift and multiply steps, masks it to 31 bits and scales by 2^-31 to a float below 1

name: SampleSmoothNoise
evidence: splits the time 2*x*clock+y into integer and fraction, takes HashToUnitFloat of the two neighbouring integers (reshaped by z, mirrored on odd integers) and blends with a smoothstep of the fraction

name: ApplyBiasCurve
evidence: returns value / (1 + (1/denominator - 2) * (1 - value))

name: EvaluateNoiseBlend
evidence: weight-averages SampleSmoothNoise over the blob's entries, passes the average through ApplyBiasCurve with the blob's scale and returns lo + that * (hi - lo)

name: EvaluateOscillator
evidence: UpdateAttachments calls it on each chained node: once per clock time (+0x34 keeps the last), rebuilds the frames when +0x8E4 is set (RefreshOscillatorFrames), then for each 0xD0-byte entry at +0x50 turns kind 0 by the sine and cosine of 2 pi (time * rate + phase) and kind 1 by a noise blend (EvaluateNoiseBlend)

name: AddOscillatorXEntry
evidence: the script built-in func_00107040 calls it: appends a 0xD0-byte entry at +0x50 of a class 0x8D object (count at +0x38, current index at +0x6D0) with the unit X vector, reusing the pending index at +0x40 or taking the next from +0x3C

name: AddOscillatorYZEntry
evidence: the script built-in func_001070E0 calls it: appends a 0xD0-byte entry of kind 1 at +0x50 of a class 0x8D object with the unit Y and Z vectors and both its weights at 0.5, counting it at +0x38 and +0x3C

name: GetOscillatorCurrentEntry
evidence: returns the 0xD0-byte entry at the index +0x6D0 of a class 0x8D object, or 0 when it has none, setting +0x8E4 when the mode is 1

name: GetOscillatorEntryForPeriod
evidence: returns GetOscillatorCurrentEntry of the object and its mode (1 marks the frames dirty), passing a third word 0 that GetOscillatorCurrentEntry does not read; SetOscillatorEntryPeriod, GetOscillatorEntryPeriod and the script built-ins (func_00109488) use it

name: GetOscillatorEntryForVectors
evidence: as GetOscillatorEntryForPeriod with the unread third word 1: returns GetOscillatorCurrentEntry of the object and its mode; AddOscillatorEntryVectorA and B and the script built-ins (func_00109488) use it

name: SetOscillatorEntryPeriod
evidence: stores the reciprocal of the value (0 for 0) as the current entry's scale (the script built-in func_00109488 calls it)

name: GetOscillatorEntryPeriod
evidence: returns the reciprocal of the current entry's scale (0 for 0), the value SetOscillatorEntryPeriod stores

name: AppendVector4ToBuffer
evidence: appends four floats to a buffer of capacity 4 (count at +4) and increments the count

name: AddOscillatorEntryVectorA
evidence: appends four floats to the four-vector buffer at +0x30 of the current entry (GetOscillatorEntryForVectors, AppendVector4ToBuffer); the script built-in func_00107180 calls it

name: AddOscillatorEntryVectorB
evidence: appends four floats to the four-vector buffer at +0x80 of the current entry (GetOscillatorEntryForVectors, AppendVector4ToBuffer); the script built-in func_00107268 calls it

name: InitTransformObject
evidence: InitObject then copies the identity matrix into the rotation field at +0x40

name: ReadTransformObject
evidence: reads a buffered rotation, a buffered vector and the property records of an object from a stream

name: ReparentObjectKeepingTransform
evidence: converts the object's pos and rot from its old parent's frame to the new one (func_00128018, func_00128150) and calls ReparentObject

name: TransformObjectIntoFrame
evidence: slot 22 of class 0x73: transforms its position and rotation by the other object's frame with func_00128018 and func_00128150

name: ConvertPointIntoObjectFrame
evidence: converts a point out of its frame (func_00128018), subtracts the object's position (+0x40) and turns it by the transpose of its rotation (+0x50): the point in the object's own frame; func_00141170 calls it

name: GetObjectWorldPosition
evidence: converts the vector at +0x40 out of the object's parent frame (func_00128018 with frame 0) into the output; used as the position getter by many callers

name: GetObjectWorldRotation
evidence: same for the rotation at +0x50 with func_00128150, into the output

name: FindArrivalPoint
evidence: finds the class 0x74 object with an id (under a parent id) for FindOrActivateSwitchedCollider; failing that, of all class 0x74 objects, the one with the id, else one with +0x94 set while a style 2 screen fade runs, else one with a record

name: LoadArrivalPoint
evidence: slot 10 of class 0x74: reads its rotation and position, its property records, a count of typed records it creates (CreateTypedRecord) and loads, and a list of 16-bit ids

name: CopyArrivalPoint
evidence: slot 9 of class 0x74: runs CopyObjectData and makes copies of the other's records (CreateObjectCopy) into a new array

name: StartArrivalPoint
evidence: slot 16 of class 0x74: runs StartObject and, for each of its records, calls its slot 21 with +0x18 and starts it (ResolveAndStartObject)

name: PlaceAtArrivalPoint
evidence: with a class 0x74 object (the one FindArrivalPoint found, for FindOrActivateSwitchedCollider; also func_00101950 and func_0017BCD0): gives the current switched collider (GetCurrentSwitchedCollider) the point's world rotation and position (GetObjectWorldRotation, GetObjectWorldPosition) and activates it (ActivateSwitchedCollider); with none it moves the camera there

name: SetTransformObjectKeyedValue
evidence: stores four script arguments in the object's four-entry keyed table at +0xB8 (count +0xB4) through UpsertKeyedEntry; the script built-in func_00101860 calls it

name: StoreValueAndMarkSet
evidence: stores a float at +0x9C and sets the word at +0x98 to 1; it has no caller, its address is filled into the object property records by FillObjectPropertyTable (func_00109488)

name: FindOrActivateSwitchedCollider
evidence: RunPendingWorldLoad's helper: returns func_001F4008 of the object func_001F3C38 finds, else the active switched collider, else activates the current one

name: FindActiveObjectSubGroup
evidence: collects up to 64 objects of class 0x7D from the world and returns the first whose field 0x2D0 is nonzero

name: BeginLevelExit
evidence: ExitLevelFromPauseMenu, ActivatePauseMenuSelection and RunAnimationEvent call it: in level 5 or a level without its +0x78 flag starts the object fade D_00247AD0, else with a sub-level hands the active object sub-group to StartObjectSubGroupFinish, else starts the screen fade with D_00275B04

name: LoadObjectSubGroup
evidence: slot 10 of class 0x7D: reads the stream into the fields at 0x2FC.., then creates count children with func_0011E580 and loads each through slot 10

name: StartObjectSubGroup
evidence: slot 16 of class 0x7D: runs StartPlacedObject, runs slots 15 and 16 of each child, and may run slot 3 of the topmost parent

name: SetObjectSubGroupState
evidence: sets the group's state 0x2E4 and stamps the clock at 0x2E8; state 5 also sets bit 40 of the flags and calls func_001DDA20

name: StartObjectSubGroupFinish
evidence: finishes a best-time run in progress (FinishBestTimeRun) or, for a group that leaves (+0x2D8), runs BeginLevelExit; else sets state 5, starts its animations and sets its end time +0x31C, and raises its script event 2

name: StartObjectSubGroupFade
evidence: picks one of two text/value pairs by a game-state condition and starts a screen fade with StartScreenFade

name: UpdateObjectSubGroup
evidence: slot 17 of class 0x7D, its override of UpdatePlacedObject; it finishes the group with StartObjectSubGroupFinish

name: InitLookupObject
evidence: slot 0 of class 0x4E: runs InitPlacedObject and sets its id to -1

name: StartLookupObject
evidence: slot 16 of class 0x4E: finds the object with its id in the world and keeps it in 0x2D8 (flag 1) or 0x2D4 (class 0x7E)

name: PushObjectCameraController
evidence: once (flag at 0x310) pushes a controller for the object on the camera stack with PushCameraController (key 7)

name: RemoveObjectCameraController
evidence: when the flag at 0x310 is set removes the object's camera controller with RemoveCameraControllers and clears the flag

name: InitContactTracker
evidence: slot 0 of class 0x36: runs InitCollider, sets up its record at 0x550, sets 0x4E0 to 1 and the flag bits 36 to 39 to 2

name: StartContactTracker
evidence: slot 16 of class 0x36: runs StartPlacedObject, then FillTrackedNodes on the record at 0x550

name: CollectTouchingObjects
evidence: slot 17 of class 0x36: walks the contact table, and for each contact whose near part is a descendant of itself and whose far part is of kind 0x41 adds it to slots (up to 10), then starts func_00177838 for each

name: CopyContactTracker
evidence: slot 9 of class 0x36: runs CopyCollider and points the record's owner at itself

name: ApplyContactTrackerTransform
evidence: slot 0xA0 of class 0x36: only calls the base func_00125C90

name: RequestContactTrackerLaunch
evidence: slot 71 of class 0x36: offers the player a launch at its tracked nodes (OfferTrackedNodeLaunch) and returns 1

name: GetContactTrackerRecord
evidence: returns the record at +0x550 of the contact tracker (the script built-in func_00109488 calls it)

name: ClearTrackedNodes
evidence: sets the record's found count to 0

name: InitC37
evidence: slot 0 of class 0x37: runs InitContactTracker, sets bit 43 of the flags at +0x538 and sets the collider's anchors to 3, 0, 3, 0

name: UpdateC37
evidence: original assembly: slot 0x54 of class 0x37, its update slot: runs UpdateCollider, collects its mesh hits with the active switched collider (GetActiveSwitchedCollider, CollectMeshHits, AddMeshContacts) and offers the player a launch at its tracked nodes (OfferTrackedNodeLaunch)

name: InitTrackedNodes
evidence: sets the record's owner, zeroes 0x04 and sets 0x08 to 150.0

name: FillTrackedNodes
evidence: adds the owner's children of id 0x7E or 0x6E to nodes (up to 32), then each object found for the ids in keys through AddTrackedNode

name: LaunchPlayerAtTrackedNode
evidence: the callback OfferTrackedNodeLaunch hands over: picks the best target among the record's nodes (ChooseBestTargetCandidate); with nodes found sets the player on the arc to it and puts it in state 2, else LaunchPlayerAtTarget

name: OfferTrackedNodeLaunch
evidence: fills the request with the record's word +0x04, the record and LaunchPlayerAtTrackedNode as its callback, and raises script event 2 on the record's owner (RequestAttachedSetLaunch, RequestContactTrackerLaunch)

name: AddTrackedKey
evidence: appends an id to keys (up to 32) and counts it

name: AddTrackedNode
evidence: appends the object to nodes (up to 32) if it is of kind 0x7E, 0x6E, 0x76, 0x70, 0x71 or 0x81

name: RemoveTrackedNode
evidence: removes the entry from nodes by shifting the later ones down and decrements found
